# SETUP AND LOAD LIBRARIES

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(future)
```

# LOAD SINGLETS DATA

```{r}
INPUT_OBJECT_PATH <- "data/processed/combined_singlets_filtered.rds"
SAVE_OBJECT_PATH <- "data/processed/combined_integrated_clustered.rds"

if (!file.exists(INPUT_OBJECT_PATH)) {
    stop("ERROR: Singlet-filtered object not found. Run 03_doublet_detection.Rmd first!")
}
combined_integrated <- readRDS(INPUT_OBJECT_PATH)

print(paste("Loaded singlet object with", ncol(combined_integrated), "nuclei and", nrow(combined_integrated), "features."))
```

# BATCH CORRECTION VIA SCT INTEGRATION
Integrate data from different samples (Sample_ID) to mitigate batch effects.

```{r}
PC_TO_USE <- 30 

# Split the object by the batch variable
seurat_list <- SplitObject(combined_integrated, split.by = "Sample_ID")

# Select features for integration (using features from the 'SCT' assay)
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = seurat_list, 
                                      nfeatures = 3000)

# Prepare for integration
seurat_list <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = seurat_list, 
                                  anchor.features = features)

# Find integration anchors
anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = seurat_list, 
                                  normalization.method = "SCT", 
                                  anchor.features = features, 
                                  dims = 1:PC_TO_USE,
                                  verbose = FALSE)

# Integrate the data (stored in the new 'integrated' assay)
combined_integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors, 
                                     normalization.method = "SCT", 
                                     dims = 1:PC_TO_USE,
                                     verbose = FALSE)

# Set the default assay to the batch-corrected 'integrated' data
DefaultAssay(combined_integrated) <- "integrated"
print("SCT Integration complete. Default assay set to 'integrated'.")
```

# DIMENSIONALITY REDUCTION AND CLUSTERING

## PCA and UMAP

```{r}
# Run PCA on the integrated assay
combined_integrated <- RunPCA(combined_integrated, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)

# Run UMAP on the integrated PCs
combined_integrated <- RunUMAP(combined_integrated, 
                               reduction = "pca", 
                               dims = 1:PC_TO_USE, 
                               verbose = FALSE)
```

## Clustering

```{r}
# Construct the Shared Nearest Neighbor (SNN) graph
combined_integrated <- FindNeighbors(combined_integrated, 
                                     reduction = "pca", 
                                     dims = 1:PC_TO_USE, 
                                     verbose = FALSE)

#  Apply the Louvain algorithm to cluster the cells
combined_integrated <- FindClusters(combined_integrated, 
                                     resolution = 0.8,  # Adjust resolution as needed
                                     verbose = FALSE)

# Check the number of clusters found
table(combined_integrated@active.ident)
```

## Visualization of Integrated Results

```{r}
# Plot UMAP colored by Cluster ID
p_umap_clusters <- DimPlot(combined_integrated, 
                           reduction = "umap", 
                           label = TRUE, 
                           repel = TRUE,
                           group.by = "seurat_clusters") + 
                           labs(title = paste0("UMAP: ", table(combined_integrated@active.ident) %>% length(), " Clusters Found"))

# Plot UMAP colored by Sample ID (Verify batch effect removal)
p_umap_sample <- DimPlot(combined_integrated, 
                         reduction = "umap", 
                         group.by = "Sample_ID") + 
                         labs(title = "UMAP Colored by Sample (Post-Integration)")

# Combine plots
p_combined_integration <- p_umap_clusters | p_umap_sample
print(p_combined_integration)
ggsave("plots/04_UMAP_Integrated_Clustering.png", p_combined_integration, width = 14, height = 6)
```

# SAVE THE INTEGRATED OBJECT

```{r}
# Save the final integrated and clustered object for marker finding (Step 5)
saveRDS(combined_integrated, file = SAVE_OBJECT_PATH)
print(paste("Step 4 Complete: Integrated and clustered Seurat object saved to:", SAVE_OBJECT_PATH))
```
